# jamfplatform_pro_removable_mac_address (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro removable MAC address by ID or by exact MAC address. Exactly one of `id` or `mac_address` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `removable-mac-address:read` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_removable_mac_address" "example_by_id" {
  id = "3"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_removable_mac_address" "example_by_mac_address" {
  mac_address = "00:A0:C9:14:C8:20"
}

output "removable_mac_address_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_removable_mac_address.example_by_id
}

output "removable_mac_address_example_by_mac_address" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_removable_mac_address.example_by_mac_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Removable MAC address ID. Mutually exclusive with `mac_address`.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
